room_west_of_house_first: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door. There is a small mailbox here. The afternoon sun casts long shadows across the overgrown lawn. Something about this place feels... significant.
room_west_of_house: West of the white house. The mailbox stands sentinel, as always.
room_north_of_house_first: You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded up. A narrow path winds north through the trees.
room_north_of_house: The north side of the house. Still no door. Still boarded up. The house is committed to its privacy.
room_south_of_house_first: You are facing the south side of a white house. A path leads southwest through the forest.
room_east_of_house_first: Behind the house, you find a small window that is slightly ajar. Curtains billow gently in the breeze, as if inviting you in.
room_east_of_house: Behind the house. The window beckons.
room_kitchen_first: You find yourself in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. Through the doorway to the west, you can see a living room. A dark staircase leads upward.
room_kitchen: The kitchen. Crumbs on the table suggest someone was here not long ago.
room_living_room_first: The living room is tastefully furnished. A trophy case stands against the wall, conspicuously empty. A large oriental rug covers the center of the floor, with an odd lump beneath it. An exit leads east to the kitchen.
room_living_room: The living room. The trophy case watches you expectantly.
room_attic_first: This is the attic. The only exit is a stairway leading down. In one corner is a dusty table bearing a nasty-looking knife and a length of rope.
room_attic: The attic. Dusty, cramped, and full of regret.
room_cellar_first: You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a stairway leading up. The sound of dripping water echoes somewhere in the darkness below. Welcome to the Great Underground Empire.
room_cellar: The cellar. Your gateway to the underground. The dripping hasn't stopped.
room_troll_room_first: This is a small room with passages leading south and east. A menacing troll stands here, blocking the eastern passage. He is brandishing a bloody axe and eyeing you with the kind of enthusiasm usually reserved for lunch.
room_troll_room: The troll room. The smell alone could fell a lesser adventurer.
room_maze_entrance_first: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike. The walls press close. Every direction looks the same. You are already lost.
room_maze_entrance: A maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
room_maze_2: A maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
room_maze_3: A maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
room_maze_dead_end_first: Dead end. The passage narrows to nothing. Something has scratched marks into the wall here — claw marks, by the look of them. Recent ones.
room_maze_dead_end: Dead end. The claw marks seem fresher than before. Probably your imagination.
room_round_room_first: You are in a circular room with passages leading in several directions. The ceiling arches high above, carved with ancient symbols that seem to shift when you're not looking directly at them.
room_round_room: The round room. The carvings on the ceiling are in different positions than you remember.
room_cyclops_room_first: A huge one-eyed creature sits in the corner of this room, blocking a stairway that leads upward. The Cyclops regards you with mild curiosity, the way you might regard a particularly interesting sandwich.
room_cyclops_room: The Cyclops room. He's still here. Still hungry-looking.
room_treasure_room_first: This room is filled with a dazzling collection of treasures, piled high in gleaming heaps. Gold, jewels, and artifacts of incredible craftsmanship catch what little light reaches here.
room_treasure_room: The treasure room. Even with things missing, it's still impressive.
look_mailbox: A small mailbox stands here with its flag raised. Someone might have left you something.
look_leaflet: The leaflet reads: 'WELCOME TO ZORK! You are about to embark on an adventure of great peril and modest reward. The Great Underground Empire awaits. Please watch your step, and do try not to die.'
look_brass_lantern: A sturdy brass lantern. The fuel gauge reads... well, it doesn't have a gauge. But it feels about three-quarters full. You'll want to conserve it.
look_elvish_sword: The elvish sword bears etchings of an ancient language. It glows with a faint blue light that seems to pulse gently, as if it has a heartbeat. The blade is razor-sharp despite its age.
look_nasty_knife: A nasty-looking knife. The kind of knife that has stories to tell, none of them pleasant.
look_trophy_case: The trophy case gleams emptily. It has room for many treasures. Perhaps you should find some.
look_oriental_rug: A beautiful oriental rug, intricately woven with patterns that might be a map, or might be purely decorative. There's definitely something lumpy underneath it.
look_trap_door: A heavy wooden trap door set into the floor. Beyond it, darkness. And dripping. Always with the dripping.
look_window: A small window in the east wall. It's slightly ajar, and a gentle breeze stirs the curtains.
look_troll: The troll is a fearsome creature — stocky, muscular, and possessed of an axe that has clearly seen extensive use. He blocks the eastern passage with the confidence of someone who has never lost a fight. Or at least, never lost one he remembers.
look_cyclops: The Cyclops is enormous — easily twice your height. Its single eye, centered in its broad forehead, tracks your movements with an intelligence that's somehow more unsettling than simple hostility. It's said that these creatures have long memories. Perhaps it knows something about a certain Greek hero...
no_exit: There is no exit in that direction.
death_grue: Oh dear. It appears you have been eaten by a grue. If it's any consolation, the grue found you quite delicious. They have, it must be said, excellent taste.
death_troll: The troll's axe finds its mark with the mechanical precision of a creature that has been doing this for centuries. Your adventuring career comes to an abrupt and somewhat messy conclusion.
death_thief: The thief's stiletto slides between your ribs with professional grace. He pauses to tip his hat, rifles through your pockets, and vanishes into the shadows. At least he appreciated your collection.
death_drowning: The water closes over your head. It's actually rather peaceful down here. The fish seem nice. This isn't the worst way to go, all things considered.
death_fall: You fall for what feels like a very long time. Long enough to contemplate your choices. Long enough to compose a brief autobiography. Long enough to—
death_generic: You have died. The universe notes your passing with characteristic indifference.
idle_1: The adventurer stands motionless, contemplating the void. The Grue considers this an invitation.
idle_2: You appear to be doing nothing. This is, historically, not a survival strategy in the Great Underground Empire.
idle_3: Time passes. The lamp burns. The darkness watches.
idle_4: If you're waiting for the puzzles to solve themselves, I have disappointing news.
idle_5: The narrator clears his throat pointedly.
idle_6: Are you still there? The Great Underground Empire doesn't explore itself. Well, actually, the thief does a pretty good job of it. But he doesn't share.
troll_combat_start: The troll raises its axe and charges! This seems like a good time to use that sword.
troll_combat_hit: Your blade finds its mark! The troll stumbles backward, looking more surprised than hurt.
troll_combat_miss: The troll sidesteps your attack with surprising grace for something so ugly.
troll_combat_dodge: You duck just in time. The axe whistles past your ear, trimming a few hairs.
troll_combat_fail_dodge: Too slow! The troll's axe catches you across the shoulder. That's going to leave a mark.
troll_defeated: With a final, desperate swing, you land a decisive blow. The troll crumples to the ground, its axe clattering away. It lets out a sound somewhere between a groan and a whimper, then crawls away into the shadows. The eastern passage is now clear.
troll_already_defeated: The troll room. A few bloodstains on the ground are the only reminder of your earlier encounter.
use_sword_on_troll: You raise the elvish sword, which pulses with eager blue light. The troll narrows its eyes. Here we go.
rug_moved: You roll back the oriental rug, revealing a closed trap door set into the floor. The narrator would like to note that this was not subtle.
trap_door_opened: The trap door opens with a reluctant creak, revealing a dark stairway leading down. A cold draft rises from below, carrying the scent of earth and ancient stone. And something else. Something watching.
window_opened: You push the window open. It slides up with a soft groan. Beyond it, you can see a modest kitchen.
treasure_placed: You place the {item} carefully in the trophy case. It catches the light beautifully. The case seems almost... satisfied.
too_heavy: Your load is too heavy. You'll need to drop something first.
room_forest_west_first: You are in a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around you. Paths lead off in several directions through the underbrush. The white house is visible to the east through the trees.
room_forest_west: The forest. Birds chirp overhead, indifferent to your quest.
room_forest_path_first: This is a path winding through a dense forest. The trees here are ancient, their canopy so thick that only scattered shafts of sunlight reach the ground. The path splits in several directions.
room_forest_path: The forest path. The trees watch in silence.
room_clearing_first: You are in a clearing surrounded by dense forest. An enormous tree stands at the center, its trunk wider than you could wrap your arms around. High in its branches, a nest of some kind is visible. Paths lead in several directions.
room_clearing: The clearing. The great tree stands watch, as it has for centuries.
room_canyon_view_first: You are standing at the top of a great canyon. Far below, a river winds its way through rocky walls. The view is breathtaking — and vertigo-inducing. A precarious path leads down.
room_canyon_view: The canyon overlook. Still a long way down.
room_rocky_ledge_first: You are on a narrow rocky ledge partway down the canyon wall. The wind whips at your clothes. The path continues both up and down, though 'down' is a generous description for what looks more like controlled falling.
room_rocky_ledge: The rocky ledge. Your knees remember the climb.
room_canyon_bottom_first: You have reached the bottom of the canyon. A river rushes past to the north, its water dark and swift. The canyon walls tower above you on all sides. The massive concrete face of a dam is visible downstream.
room_canyon_bottom: The canyon bottom. The river rushes endlessly past.
room_narrow_passage_first: This is a narrow east-west passageway. The walls are close enough to touch on both sides. There is a musty smell of old stone and something else — something ancient.
room_narrow_passage: The narrow passage. Still narrow. Still a passage.
room_loud_room_first: This is a large room with a ceiling that seems to vibrate with the roar of rushing water from somewhere below. The noise is tremendous — every sound you make is swallowed by the constant thunder. A platinum bar sits on a ledge, trembling with the vibrations.
room_loud_room: The Loud Room. WHAT? I SAID, THE LOUD ROOM.
room_deep_canyon_first: You are on the edge of a deep underground canyon. A thin path winds along the canyon wall, with a dizzying drop to your left. You can hear rushing water far below.
room_deep_canyon: The deep canyon. Don't look down. Seriously.
room_damp_cave_first: This cave is damp and chilly. Water seeps from the walls, making everything slippery. Stalactites hang from the ceiling like stone teeth.
room_damp_cave: The damp cave. Your socks will never forgive you.
room_strange_passage_first: This is a winding passage that connects to familiar-looking rooms on both ends. The walls here are oddly smooth, as if carved by something other than nature. Or perhaps by nature in an unusually meticulous mood.
room_strange_passage: The strange passage. You feel like you've been here before — in a different context.
room_dam_first: You are standing on the top of Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a feat of engineering in its day. The dam spans a great underground river, and the view from up here is impressive — if you enjoy staring into abyssal darkness. A control panel is built into the railing, and a path leads south into the dam structure.
room_dam: Flood Control Dam #3. Still holding back an ocean of darkness.
room_dam_lobby_first: This is a large room inside the dam structure. The walls are concrete, cold, and institutional. A rack near the entrance holds some dusty tourist guidebooks. Exits lead north to the dam, east to a maintenance room, and south into the depths.
room_dam_lobby: The dam lobby. The guidebooks are optimistic about the dam's structural integrity.
room_maintenance_room_first: This is the maintenance room of Flood Control Dam #3. The room is filled with machinery and control panels. A blue button labeled 'DRAIN' and a yellow button labeled 'FILL' dominate one wall. Both look rusted in place. A wrench lies on a workbench.
room_maintenance_room: The maintenance room. The buttons await your command.
room_dam_base_first: You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3. The immense concrete wall towers above you, a monument to engineering ambition and questionable underground zoning permits. Water trickles from cracks in the structure.
room_dam_base: The dam base. The dam looms overhead, somewhat ominously.
room_reservoir_south_first: You are at the southern edge of a large underground reservoir. The water is still and dark, reflecting nothing. The dam is visible to the south.
room_reservoir_south: The reservoir. The water is unnervingly calm.
look_wrench: A heavy wrench with an adjustable head. Just the thing for loosening rusted bolts — or for less constructive purposes, should the mood strike.
look_platinum_bar: A bar of pure platinum. It's incredibly heavy and incredibly valuable. How it ended up in an underground room is a question for the archaeologists.
look_guidebook: The guidebook is titled 'Flood Control Dam #3: A Guide for the Curious Adventurer.' It mentions that the dam controls include a DRAIN button and a FILL button, accessible from the maintenance room. It also mentions that the dam was constructed during the reign of Lord Dimwit Flathead the Excessive, which explains a lot.
look_crystal_trident: A trident carved from a single enormous crystal. It refracts light into tiny rainbows. Poseidon would be jealous.
look_pile_of_leaves: A pile of autumn leaves that has accumulated in the clearing. It rustles occasionally in the breeze.
look_bird_nest: High in the branches of the enormous tree, you can see a large nest. Something inside it catches the light.
death_thief_combat: The thief's blade is faster than your reflexes. Much faster. He pauses to admire his handiwork, pockets your valuables, and disappears. Professional to the last.
thief_combat_start: The thief draws a wicked stiletto and drops into a fighting stance. His eyes are cold and professional. This is not his first dance.
thief_combat_hit: Your blade catches the thief's arm! He hisses in pain but doesn't drop his guard.
thief_combat_miss: The thief sidesteps with liquid grace. He's fast — unnervingly fast.
thief_combat_dodge: You duck under the thief's slash. The stiletto whispers past your ear.
thief_combat_fail_dodge: The thief's stiletto finds its mark. A line of fire traces across your ribs.
look_thief: A lean figure in a dark cloak, face half-hidden in shadow. His eyes glitter with intelligence and avarice. A stiletto gleams in one hand. He moves with the practiced ease of someone who has spent a lifetime taking things that don't belong to him.
room_temple_first: You are in a vast temple of ancient stone. Massive pillars rise to a vaulted ceiling lost in shadow. The air is heavy with the scent of old incense and older secrets. Passages lead north, east, and south. Carved figures watch you from the walls with empty stone eyes.
room_temple: The temple. The stone figures on the walls have not moved. You're fairly sure.
room_egyptian_room_first: This room is decorated in the style of ancient Egypt. The walls are covered in hieroglyphics painted in faded gold and lapis. A golden coffin rests against the far wall, and the air smells of dust and something faintly sweet — myrrh, perhaps, or the memory of it.
room_egyptian_room: The Egyptian room. The hieroglyphics seem to shift slightly when you look away. They don't.
room_altar_first: A massive stone altar dominates this chamber, hewn from a single block of obsidian-dark rock. The air thrums with a low, almost subsonic vibration. Three indentations are carved into the altar's surface — one shaped like a bell, one like an open book, and three small circles. Below, a dark passage leads down, but an unearthly wailing rises from its depths.
room_altar: The altar chamber. The stone altar waits with infinite patience. It has nowhere else to be.
room_hades_entrance_first: The air here is deathly cold. You stand at the threshold between the world of the living and whatever lies beyond. A gate of ghostly light shimmers before you, and the walls are slick with condensation that might be tears. The passage continues south into darkness.
room_hades_entrance: The entrance to Hades. Still cold. Still uninviting. Still better than a staff meeting.
room_land_of_dead_first: You have entered the Land of the Dead. Pale figures drift through an endless grey twilight, their faces blank and their movements aimless. The silence here is not the absence of sound — it is the presence of something else entirely. A crystal skull gleams incongruously among the gloom.
room_land_of_dead: The Land of the Dead. The spirits continue their eternal commute to nowhere.
room_coal_mine_entrance_first: The entrance to an abandoned coal mine yawns before you like a missing tooth in the earth's smile. Rusted rail tracks disappear into the darkness below. A warning sign has been posted with the kind of optimism that suggests it was ignored even when the mine was operational.
room_coal_mine_entrance: The coal mine entrance. The warning sign judges you silently.
room_shaft_room_first: You are in a tall, narrow chamber dominated by a deep mine shaft. Timber supports creak and groan around you like a wooden chorus of complaint. A rusted ladder clings to one wall with the determination of someone who hasn't been told they've been made redundant.
room_shaft_room: The shaft room. The timbers are still creaking. They haven't stopped since you arrived. They won't stop after you leave.
room_timber_room_first: This section of the mine is supported by heavy timber beams. The wood is old and dark, and the air smells of earth and sawdust. The beams groan softly, as if discussing the weight of their responsibilities.
room_timber_room: The timber room. The beams continue their quiet structural anxiety.
room_drafty_room_first: A cold draft blows through this chamber, strong enough to ruffle your hair and carry away any sense of comfort. The source appears to be a crack in the eastern wall. The draft carries a faint chemical smell that grows stronger to the south.
room_drafty_room: The drafty room. The draft persists. It is committed to its craft.
room_gas_room_first: The air here is thick and acrid, with a greenish haze seeping from cracks in the floor. Your eyes water. Your nose objects. Every survival instinct you possess is suggesting, in the strongest possible terms, that you should not bring any open flames into this room.
room_gas_room: The gas room. Still toxic. Still inadvisable. Still here.
room_machine_room_first: A massive machine fills most of this room, a bewildering assemblage of gears, pipes, hoppers, and levers. A brass plate on its side reads: 'FROBOZZ MAGIC COAL COMPANY — AUTOMATIC TORCH MAKER'. It has the look of something built by engineers who were paid by the gear.
room_machine_room: The machine room. The machine waits with mechanical patience for something to process.
look_bell: A tarnished brass bell with a wooden handle. When you shake it gently, it produces a clear, resonant tone that seems to hang in the air longer than physics should allow.
look_prayer_book: An ancient prayer book, its leather binding cracked with age. The text is in a language you cannot read — possibly because the language predates reading. The illustrations are unsettling in a way that's hard to articulate.
look_candles: Three ivory candles, each carved with tiny symbols that might be runes or might be a very small grocery list. They feel cold to the touch, as if they've been stored somewhere that hasn't seen warmth in centuries.
look_gold_coffin: An ornate golden coffin, covered in hieroglyphics. Despite being made of gold, it's surprisingly light. Either the ancient Egyptians knew something about metallurgy that we don't, or this is hollow. Probably best not to open it.
look_crystal_skull: A skull carved from pure crystal, polished to an unsettling clarity. No matter which way you turn it, the empty eye sockets seem to follow you. It's the kind of thing that would look great on a mantelpiece, if you enjoy your mantelpiece accessories judging you.
look_coal: A large, dense lump of coal. In another life, this might have been a diamond. In this life, it's a lump of coal. We don't always get what we want.
look_stiletto: The thief's stiletto — a thin, wickedly sharp blade designed for precision rather than power. It's the kind of weapon that says 'I could hurt you, but I'd rather you didn't see it coming.'
death_explosion: The gas ignites. For a brief, glorious moment, you are the brightest thing in the Great Underground Empire. Then you are the most scattered.
room_reservoir_north_first: The northern shore of the reservoir stretches before you. The water is dark and still, with an oily sheen. The dam is visible to the east.
room_reservoir_north: The reservoir's north shore. The water hasn't moved.
room_stream_view_first: You stand overlooking a gentle stream that feeds the reservoir. The sound of running water is peaceful — a rare commodity underground. Trees line the banks.
room_stream_view: Stream view. The water babbles on, oblivious to your quest.
room_river_bank_first: You are on the bank of a wide underground river. The current is strong and dark. A deflated rubber raft lies on the shore, looking rather sorry for itself.
room_river_bank: The river bank. The raft awaits, deflated and judgmental.
room_aragain_falls_first: You stand at the edge of Aragain Falls, where the river plunges into a vast underground chasm. The roar is immense. Mist billows upward, and in the spray, a magnificent rainbow arcs across the void. It's beautiful. It's also extremely non-solid.
room_aragain_falls: Aragain Falls. The rainbow shimmers in the mist.
room_rainbow_room_first: You are standing on a rainbow. Let that sink in. Beneath your feet, bands of color shift and pulse with gentle warmth. The view from up here is extraordinary — the falls below, the cavern stretching in all directions.
room_rainbow_room: On the rainbow. Still magical. Still improbable.
room_end_of_rainbow_first: You have reached the end of the rainbow. And yes, there is a pot of gold here. The universe, it seems, has a sense of humor after all.
room_end_of_rainbow: The end of the rainbow. The pot of gold gleams patiently.
room_mirror_room_north_first: This room is dominated by a massive mirror that covers the entire north wall. Your reflection stares back at you, but there's something unsettling about it — the movements are just slightly off, as if your reflection is thinking about something you're not.
room_mirror_room_north: The mirror room. Your reflection looks tired.
room_mirror_room_south_first: Another mirror room, this one with the mirror on the south wall. The effect is disorienting — mirrors reflecting mirrors, creating infinite corridors of increasingly worried-looking adventurers.
room_mirror_room_south: The southern mirror room. Infinite yous, infinite problems.
room_gallery_first: This is an art gallery, though 'gallery' is generous. The walls are lined with empty frames, save for one that holds a painting of extraordinary beauty — a pastoral scene that seems to shift subtly when you're not looking directly at it.
room_gallery: The gallery. The painting watches you watching it.
room_studio_first: This appears to have been an artist's studio. An easel stands in the center, bearing an empty canvas. Dried paint cakes every surface. Brushes lie scattered as if thrown down in frustration — or terror.
room_studio: The studio. The empty canvas somehow feels accusatory.
look_sceptre: A magnificent sceptre adorned with jewels. It emanates a warm, golden glow that seems to intensify near water.
look_pot_of_gold: A pot brimming with gold coins, each one stamped with the seal of the Great Underground Empire. It's the kind of treasure that makes the whole adventure worthwhile.
look_painting_room: A painting of remarkable beauty. The pastoral scene seems almost alive — the trees sway, the water sparkles. You could stare at it for hours. The frame alone is probably worth a fortune.
look_raft_deflated: A rubber raft, currently flat as a pancake. There's a valve on one side for inflation. You'd need some kind of pump.
look_air_pump: A sturdy hand-operated air pump. The label reads 'FROBOZZ MAGIC AIR PUMP CO.' Guaranteed to inflate anything, or your zorkmids back.
look_odysseus_scroll: The scroll tells the tale of Odysseus, who defeated the Cyclops Polyphemus not through strength but through cunning. 'Nobody is my name,' he told the beast. The Cyclops, it seems, was not the brightest creature. One-eyed and one-brained, as the saying goes.
look_air_pump_room: A sturdy air pump with a Frobozz Magic logo. It could inflate just about anything — rafts, balloons, egos.
look_jade_figurine: A jade figurine of a serpent, each scale individually carved. The craftsmanship is extraordinary — this must be thousands of years old.
look_silver_chalice: A silver chalice studded with rubies. The interior still gleams, untarnished by time. Whatever this was used for, it was important.
look_diamond: An enormous diamond that refracts light into a thousand tiny rainbows. You could retire on this. You could retire several times on this.
look_ancient_map: A beautifully illuminated map showing the full extent of the Great Underground Empire. It's both a treasure and genuinely useful — if you can read the ancient notation.
look_ruby: A ruby of extraordinary color and clarity. It seems to pulse with a faint inner warmth, as if it remembers the volcanic fires that created it.
look_sapphire_bracelet: A bracelet of platinum and sapphires. The gems are the deep blue of a midnight sky. It's the kind of jewelry that starts wars.
grue_warning_1: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
grue_warning_2: The darkness is absolute. Something growls nearby. Something hungry.
grue_warning_3: You are in complete darkness. The faint sound of breathing — not yours — echoes from every direction.
grue_nearby: A low, rumbling growl reverberates through the darkness. The grue is close. Very close.
room_stone_barrow_first: An ancient stone barrow rises from the earth, its weathered blocks fitted together with a precision that speaks of forgotten craftsmanship. A dark opening yawns in one side, exhaling cool air that carries the scent of ages past. This is old. Older than the house. Older, perhaps, than memory.
room_stone_barrow: The stone barrow. The dark opening breathes its ancient breath.
room_forest_south_first: You are in a dense part of the forest south of the house. The trees here grow close together, their branches interlocking overhead like the fingers of old friends. Paths lead in several directions through the undergrowth.
room_forest_south: The southern forest. The trees keep their counsel.
room_behind_house_garden_first: Behind the house, a garden has gone magnificently to seed. What were once neat beds of herbs and vegetables are now a riot of weeds, wildflowers, and ambitious vines. A rusted trowel lies half-buried in the soil, abandoned by its owner to whatever fate befell them.
room_behind_house_garden: The garden. Nature's hostile takeover is well underway.
room_cliff_edge_first: You stand at the very edge of a sheer cliff. The ground simply stops, and beyond it there is nothing but air and a very long way down. The wind tugs at your clothes with the gentle insistence of someone trying to tell you something important about gravity.
room_cliff_edge: The cliff edge. Still a terrible place for a picnic.
room_dark_passage_first: This is a dark, narrow passage running north and south. The walls are rough-hewn and damp to the touch. The air is thick with the smell of wet stone and the peculiar loneliness that only underground places possess.
room_dark_passage: The dark passage. Dark. Passage. What more do you want?
room_engravings_cave_first: The walls of this cave are covered — absolutely covered — in ancient engravings. Maps, diagrams, warnings in forgotten languages, and what appear to be restaurant reviews for underground establishments long since closed. Someone spent a very long time down here with a chisel and strong opinions.
room_engravings_cave: The engravings cave. The ancient reviews are still scathing.
room_dome_room_first: You stand in a magnificent domed chamber. The ceiling arches far overhead, its surface studded with crystals that catch your light and scatter it into a thousand tiny stars. The effect is breathtaking — like standing inside a geode, if geodes were the size of cathedrals.
room_dome_room: The dome room. The crystal ceiling still dazzles.
room_torch_room_first: This chamber once held torches in iron brackets along its walls. The brackets remain, empty and rusted. Scorch marks on the stone above them speak of centuries of illumination, now extinguished. The room feels like it's waiting for someone to light it up again.
room_torch_room: The torch room. The empty brackets wait with infinite patience.
room_winding_passage_first: The passage here winds back and forth in a serpentine fashion, as if the original builders couldn't agree on which direction to tunnel. The sound of dripping water echoes from somewhere ahead, and the air grows cooler with each turn.
room_winding_passage: The winding passage. Still winding. Still a passage.
room_underground_river_first: A dark underground river flows swiftly through this cavern, its surface black and glassy in your light. The sound of rushing water fills the space. The river is wide and deep, and cold enough to make your teeth ache just looking at it.
room_underground_river: The underground river. It flows on, caring nothing for adventurers.
room_crypt_first: You have entered a crypt. Stone sarcophagi line the walls, their lids carved with the likenesses of their occupants — all of whom look profoundly displeased about their current accommodations. The central sarcophagus is larger than the rest, its lid slightly ajar, as if its occupant has been stepping out.
room_crypt: The crypt. The residents are quiet. Too quiet.
room_mine_tunnel_first: This is a side tunnel branching off from the main mine. Rusted mine cart rails run along the floor, and the timber supports here look even less confident than those in the main shaft. The air smells of coal dust and regret.
room_mine_tunnel: The mine tunnel. The rails lead nowhere useful. The supports lead nowhere reassuring.
endgame_victory: The last treasure clicks into place. The trophy case shimmers with an inner light, and for the first time, the narrator is speechless. Almost. You have done it. Every treasure recovered. Every puzzle solved. Every death survived (eventually). You are the Greatest Adventurer the Great Underground Empire has ever known. The narrator tips his metaphorical hat. Well played.
endgame_rank: Your final rank: Greatest Adventurer. The Great Underground Empire salutes you.
use_fail_generic: That doesn't seem to work. The universe appreciates your creativity, though.
use_fail_eat: You can't eat that. Well, you could try, but the narrator recommends against it.
drop_fail: You can't drop something you don't have.
attack_fail: Violence isn't the answer here. It rarely is, despite what the troll might suggest.
talk_fail: There's no response. Perhaps it's shy. Or, more likely, it's an inanimate object.
look_self: You are a slightly disheveled adventurer. Your clothes are practical, your pockets are deep, and your survival instincts are questionable at best.
look_nothing: You see nothing special about that.
hint_dark_room: It's very dark here. If you have a light source, try right-clicking it in your inventory to turn it on.
hint_first_underground: The underground awaits! Remember: your lamp has limited fuel. Conserve it when you can, and keep an eye out for the torch.
mailbox_opened: Opening the small mailbox reveals a leaflet.
look_house_exterior: The white house stands silently, its front door boarded shut. It has the look of a house that has seen things. Things it would rather forget.
look_forest_generic: Trees. More trees. The forest extends in every direction, ancient and indifferent to your passing.
look_underground_walls: The walls are rough-hewn stone, damp to the touch. Occasional chisel marks suggest this passage was carved rather than natural.
look_water_generic: The water is dark and cold. You dip a finger in experimentally. Yep. Dark and cold. Mystery solved.
room_frigid_river_1_first: You are on the Frigid River in a small raft. The current is swift and cold. The raft rocks beneath you as the river carries you southward. Banks rise steeply on either side.
room_frigid_river_1: The Frigid River. The current pulls south.
room_frigid_river_2_first: The river narrows between white cliffs. The current accelerates. Spray soaks your clothes. Going back upstream is out of the question.
room_frigid_river_2: Between the white cliffs. The current is relentless.
room_frigid_river_3_first: The river widens slightly. To the west, you can see a small cave opening in the cliff face — reachable if you're quick. A buoy ahead reads 'DANGER — FALLS AHEAD'.
room_frigid_river_3: Frigid River, near the cave. The falls roar somewhere ahead.
room_frigid_river_4_first: The river rushes toward a precipice. Heavy mist rises from below where the water plunges into Aragain Falls. The beach to the south is your last chance to make landfall.
room_frigid_river_4: Last stretch before the falls. Exit recommended.
room_sandy_beach_first: You pull ashore on a sandy beach at the base of the falls. The mist from Aragain Falls keeps everything perpetually damp. A shovel is half-buried in the sand.
room_sandy_beach: The sandy beach. Damp, quiet, and far from everything.
room_shore_cave_first: A small cave carved by the river into the cliff face. It's barely large enough to stand in. An ivory torch, too beautiful to burn, rests on a natural shelf.
room_shore_cave: The shore cave. Surprisingly cozy for a hole in a cliff.
room_maze_4_first: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
room_maze_4: A maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
room_maze_5_first: You are in a twisty maze of little passages, all alike.
room_maze_5: A twisty maze of little passages, all alike.
room_maze_6_first: You are in a maze of twisting little passages, all alike.
room_maze_6: A maze of twisting little passages, all alike.
room_maze_dead_end_2_first: Dead end. A rusted key lies on the ground, apparently dropped and forgotten.
room_maze_dead_end_2: Dead end. At least you found a key last time.
look_shovel: A sturdy shovel with a wooden handle. The blade is well-maintained despite apparent age. Perfect for digging, burying, or self-defense against the less coordinated monsters.
look_ivory_torch: A torch carved from a single piece of ivory, intricate and beautiful. Every scale of the dragon-shaped handle is individually detailed. Far too valuable to actually use as a light source.
look_rusty_key: A small brass key, heavily oxidized. It still turns, though with considerable protest. Whatever it opens, it was meant to stay locked.
room_forest_north_first: A dense forest stretches in all directions. Ancient oaks tower overhead, their branches forming a cathedral of leaves. A path leads south toward the house, and you can see other trails winding through the trees.
room_forest_north: The northern forest. The trees watch in patient silence.
room_up_a_tree_first: You have climbed up into the branches of a large tree. From here you can see over the forest canopy. An empty bird's nest sits in a fork of the branches. Below, a clearing is visible.
room_up_a_tree: Up in the tree. The view hasn't changed, but neither have your life choices.
room_forest_clearing_2_first: A small clearing in the forest, peaceful and dappled with sunlight. An enormous tree stump dominates the center — whatever tree stood here was truly ancient. Paths lead off through the undergrowth.
room_forest_clearing_2: The small clearing. The stump remains, stoic and silent.
room_overgrown_path_first: An overgrown path winds through dense thorny bushes. Nature has been working to reclaim this trail for decades, and it's winning. The path is passable, but just barely.
room_overgrown_path: The overgrown path. The thorns haven't gotten friendlier.
room_hilltop_first: You stand on a hilltop overlooking the surrounding countryside. The view is magnificent — the white house below, the dark forest stretching to the horizon, and somewhere beneath it all, the vast underground empire. Wind tugs at your clothes.
room_hilltop: The hilltop. The wind carries the faint sound of adventure.
